verdict.rationale: Glama operates as an MCP gateway/hosting platform: deploying any registry server automatically places Glama's Gateway in front of it, giving agents a single official MCP endpoint to connect through, and each server page ships pre-filled config blocks for major clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code). This directly satisfies 'connect an agent via an official MCP server' since Glama itself becomes the MCP server/gateway endpoint agents call. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the hosted Gateway endpoint works reliably in production (community evidence only covers quality-score/rebuild issues, not gateway connectivity) and no public OpenAPI/spec confirming the endpoint contract.
